summary_en: ¥130/share annual dividend FY3/27 (up from ¥74/share), 76% increase. H2 interim ¥65/share, year-end ¥65/share. Progressive dividend policy maintained per new Medium-Term Management Plan 2030.
title_en: Notice regarding upward revision of FY3/27 earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: On 22 July 2026, Mitsui Matsushima Holdings' board approved upward revision of FY3/27 (year ending March 2027) earnings guidance and dividend forecasts. Annual dividend per share increased from ¥74 to ¥130, a 56-yen or 76% increase, comprising ¥65 at the interim (H2) dividend and ¥65 at the year-end dividend. The increase reflects stronger earnings visibility driven by special gains from equity investments held by subsidiary MM Investments and expansion of the revenue base following the acquisition and consolidation of Sanyo Corporation (announced same day). The company stated it maintains a progressive dividend policy under its newly established Medium-Term Management Plan 2030, targeting sustained improvement in dividend levels while securing necessary retained earnings for stable corporate growth and operational flexibility.
